messages:
Chloe: Quick check — planning to enable `ff_cache_batch_v2` (cache + batching changes) as a canary. Intention: start with internal traffic then expand to beta customers. Any blockers?
Avani: +1. What's the exact canary plan & rollback thresholds?
Chloe: Plan proposal:
- Stage1: 0.1% internal (engineering traffic) for 30m
- Stage2: 1% beta customers for 2h
- Stage3: 5% prod ramp if metrics stable
Rollbacks: auto if error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 increases > 20% OR tail OOMs
Sam: Fine but add GPU/CPU util and queue length SLOs. Also prefer manual pause point between stage2->3.
Kevin: SRE note — need dashboard & alerts. I can set an alert for error_rate and p95. Can we define exact metric ids?
Chloe: Metrics:
- service.errors_per_1m
- service.p95_latency_ms
- node.gpu_util_pct
- queue.size
Link to draft dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/cache-batch-canary
Kevin: OK I'll wire those alerts to PagerDuty and a Slack alert to #eng-oncall.
Avani: Ran microbench on staging with dataset X. Quick numbers:
```
before: p50=32ms p95=150ms errors=0.12%
after: p50=29ms p95=185ms errors=0.14%
```
p95 regressed ~23% — that exceeds our p95 rollback threshold. Looks like some tail effect when batches combine long sequences.
Sam: Thanks Avani — that's concerning. Can we try lowering max_batch_size or use prefix cache exclusion for long sequences?
Avani: Yep. I tested reducing max_batch_size 64->32, p95 went to 160ms. Still +6.7% but within tolerance. Results:
```
after (max_batch=32): p50=30ms p95=160ms errors=0.13%
```
Chloe: Given that, new plan: start Stage1 internal 0.1% with max_batch_size=32 and prefix cache enabled. If stable for 30m, stage2 1% beta same config.
Kevin: SRE asks to also enable automatic rollback script: `redwoodctl flags watch ff_cache_batch_v2 --auto-rollback --p95 20 --err 0.5` and tag runs with `canary/2026-05-12`.
Sam: Please don't fully rely on auto-rollback for stage2->3. We'll require a manual thumbs-up.
Chloe: Agreed. Manual approval gate after stage2. I'll create the PR to set initial rollout and config.
deploy-bot: CI passed — canary config PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482
ci-bot: E2E smoke passed on canary config branch (staging env)
SRE-Oncall: I'll be on standby 30m before Stage1 and for the 2h Stage2 window. Ping me in thread when you flip the flag.
Chloe: Thanks — flipping to internal 0.1% now with `redwoodctl flags set ff_cache_batch_v2 --pct 0.1 --audience internal --config max_batch=32`
Sam: watching logs. ping me if anything spikes.
Kevin: Alerts are in place. PagerDuty set to oncall@redwood for this window.
Chloe: Stage1 started 1760348219. Will update after 30m.
Sam: seen small CPU bump on host group A, but errors steady.
Avani: tail OOMs not seen. p95 trending +5% relative to baseline.
Chloe: ok will move to Stage2 after 30m if no further regressions.
